question: Who is considered as the ‘Father of Indian Communism’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MN Roy.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Manabendra Nath Roy (21 March 1887 – 25 January 1954), born Narendra Nath Bhattacharya, was an Indian Communist revolutionary, radical activist, and political theorist, as well as a noted philosopher in the 20th century.**
 
• Roy was a founder of the Mexican Communist Party and the Communist Party of India (Tashkent group).
 
• He was also a delegate to congresses of the Communist International and Russia's aide to China.
 
• Following the rise of Joseph Stalin, Roy left the mainline communist movement to pursue independent radical politics.
 
• In 1940 Vinay Roy was instrumental in the formation of the Radical Democratic Party, an organization in which he played a leading role for much of the decade of the 1940s.
 
• In the aftermath of World War II Roy moved away from orthodox Marxism to espouse the philosophy of radical humanism, attempting to chart a third course between liberalism and communism. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9d085e26fd43a270fee95870922eb4bc254311d559b01156475e1e7fceb8f8d.png] 

 
• **Narendra Nath "Naren" Bhattacharya, later known as M. N. Roy, was born on 22 March 1887 at Arbella, located in the North 24 Parganas of West Bengal, near Calcutta (Kolkata).**
 
• **Most modern forms of communism are grounded at least nominally in Marxism, a theory and method conceived by Karl Marx during the 19th century.**
